price_anchor_footnote: (1) Published prices at a Knoxville-area chiropractic office for oxygen-enriched sessions; $125 is a first visit with consultation. Purebaric's Knoxville placements are air-only. All figures are illustrations before staff time, overhead and taxes; set your own price.
coming_line: **Coming to Knoxville.** Purebaric chambers are in use at gyms, studios and clinics today, and we are placing our first Knoxville-area chambers with a small group of businesses. You work directly with the owner, from the first call through installation and ongoing support.
